name: Himenaga Kohaku
source:
A young lady gifted with talent in both academics and athletics, who has never known the meaning of struggle.

She is deeply trusted by her teachers and admired—even worshiped—by her fellow students. While she is fully aware of her own high capabilities and noble lineage, expressing this openly in her words and actions, she possesses a virtuous nature; she makes a conscious effort to act with the sense of responsibility that comes with power, believing that because she is superior, she must fulfill her duty.

On the other hand, because she has lived without ever knowing failure, she immediately loses her composure when faced with an unexpected situation, revealing a fragile side that is the polar opposite of her usual gallant self.
